title: Initial Build Offer · All Hail King Jesus ↔ Corgi Loaf Baking Co.

analysis.executiveSummary: For All Hail King Jesus in Retool mode, acquiring Cam Skattebo and Saquon Barkley for D'Andre Swift creates immense long-term value and RB depth. However, Corgi Loaf Baking Co. is actively pursuing a Win Championship objective and cannot accept a 1-for-2 trade that guts their running back rotation. To execute a realistic transaction, All Hail King Jesus should revise the offer by adding a starting-caliber FLEX asset like Deebo Samuel Sr. to sweeten the deal for the contender.
